title: Thermal-battery CFD: an OpenFOAM conjugate heat-transfer model of a 13-stack LiSi/FeS2 thermal battery
description: OpenFOAM v2412 chtMultiRegionFoam axisymmetric conjugate heat-transfer model of a 13-stack LiSi/FeS2 thermal battery with LiF-LiCl-LiBr molten-salt electrolyte. Reproduces the reference cell of Jeong, Cho and Lee (2019, J. Power Sources 424:35-41) at +26.85 degC and extends the model to five ambient temperatures {-40, -20, 0, +26.85, +50} degC for operability envelope, discharge derating, and cold-ambient rescue-pellet energy-split accounting. Includes YAML case configurations, the twelve-configuration parameter matrix, build and extraction scripts, per-region extractions cited in the associated publication, and figure-generation code.
